events.text: The Pakistan Football Federation was created.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 5 December 1947 , after the independence from Great Britain , the Pakistan Football Federation was created

events.text: Mohammad Ali Jinnah assumed the role of Patron-in-Chief.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: Mohammad Ali Jinnah , Pakistans first leader , assumed the role of Patron-in-Chief

events.text: The PFF gained affiliation with FIFA.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1948 , the PFF gained affiliation with FIFA

events.text: The PFF was one of the founding members of the Asian Football Confederation when it was established.
events.subject: self
events.quote: one of the founding members of the Asian Football Confederation when it was established in 1954

events.text: The PFF organized the first national championship at Karachi.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It organized the first national championship in 1948 at Karachi

events.text: The PFF was under new management as Makhdoom Syed Faisal Saleh Hayat took over.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in August 2003 , the PFF was under new management , as Makhdoom Syed Faisal Saleh Hayat took over

events.text: The PFF set up a national football league.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the PFF set up a national football league in 2004

events.text: A national championship was set up for womens football.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2005 a national championship was set up for womens football

events.text: The inter-city Geo Super Football League was established.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2007 , the inter-city Geo Super Football League was established

events.text: The PFF has been going through an internal feud since the controversial third election of Makhdoom Syed Faisal Saleh Hayat.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since 2015 and the controversial third election of Makhdoom Syed Faisal Saleh Hayat , the PFF has been going through an internal feud

events.text: FIFA threatened to suspend the PFFs membership.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In July 2017 , the FIFA threatened to suspend the PFFs membership

events.text: FIFA decided to suspend the Pakistan Football Federation with immediate effect.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 11 October 2017 the FIFA decided to suspend Pakistan Football Federation ( PFF ) with immediate effect

events.subject: self
events.quote: On 13 March 2018 FIFA lifted the suspension
